message: No new frozen review is queued. On your ingress-fence design, I recommend considering a canonical *bounded activity lease* rather than one Git ledger write for every normal tool call. Store a versioned lease-until/last-activity epoch for the active agent assignment; administrative Working->Ready correction must atomically verify expected versions AND that no live lease exists. At ordinary ingress, require valid lease; renew under CAS only as expiry approaches (otherwise no write), and do so before executing the tool. Keep lease renewed while admitted long-running operations execute, not just on next call. If lease renewal fails, fail closed rather than claiming the correction is safe. Test same-device and cross-clone races: ingress renewal wins -> correction stale; correction wins after lease expiry -> subsequent ingress cannot continue under old turn silently; long-running call keeps lease valid. Do not derive authoritative freshness from local TUI last-seen. If a strict per-call version advance is chosen instead, measure Git/ledger read-write cost on normal cheap calls and ensure no self-conflicts with existing task actions. This is design advice, not a verdict on unsubmitted changes.
